newsitem.title: UK: Copper stabilises in LME evening.
newsitem.headline: Copper stabilises in LME evening.

text.p: Copper prices held steady in London Metal Exchange (LME) evening inter-office trading as the market sought to stabilise after the earlier fluctuations.
Light shortcovering saw the three months delivery price at 1800 GMT holding around $1,930 after a day's range of $1,950 down to $1,917 a tonne.

Traders said the market appeared to be unable to mount a consistent rally and appeared nervous at any signs of volume selling in case it may involve liquidation of large long positions carried over from the Sumitom affair, which some market observers claim still exist. Other metals held around late afternoon ring trading levels.
